sentences.text:
On The 9 th Of July, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 26381 of 2025
 Vishal Sharma @ Lakhan
 Versus

Appearance:
 Shri Rahul Sharma - Advocate for the petitioner.
 Shri K K Tiwari - GA appearing on behalf of Advocat  ORDER 1] They are heard.
Perused the case diary / challan papers.

2] This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,2023 (u/s 439 of Cr.P.C.), as he is implicated in connection with Crime No.192/2024 registered at Police Station Raghvi District Ujjain (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 420,419,406,467 468, 534 of IPC/BNS,2023.
The applicant is in custody since 4/1/2025.
3] Looking to the nature of offence, no case of grant bail is made out.
4] Accordingly, the present M.Cr.C. stands dismissed.
However, with liberty to the applicant to renew his prayer after the complainants are examined.
5] With the aforesaid, the M.Cr.C. stands dismissed.

(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE das Vishal Sharma @ Lakhan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134083370/
